title: Add people to a group
summary: Invites more people into a group the person can invite to: from the group's member list, or from a DM with someone ("Convidar para um grupo").

entry.description: fromGroup: pick people for this group. fromDm: pick a group for this person.

userId.description: fromDm: the other person of the DM.

groups.description: fromDm: joined groups where canOwnUserInvite is true, without the self chat (Anotações). Empty shows bipe_dm_invite_to_group_empty.

invite.effect: Checks membership first: joined or invited shows bipe_dm_invite_to_group_already_member. Else Room.inviteUserById; sent shows bipe_dm_invite_to_group_sent.

pickPeople.effect: fromGroup: the person picker of group-create (search, suggestions, @ lookup), then invite for each.

notes: An invite to a group arrives as a group invite; from a stranger it lands in Pedidos (bipe-chat/bipe#557, ADR 0016). Invite pairs skip that (ADR 0034).
A DM never gets a third member from this screen (ADR 0141). Inviting a DM's person to a group never changes the DM.
Bipe logic: BipeInviteToGroup.groups and invite (Android). iOS has the flow outside BipeKit; write it from this spec.
